param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ContextPath,
  [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SourceRepoRoot,
  [string]$RepoRoot = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "../../..")).Path
)
# Canonical validation scripts live three levels below the repository root.
# Keep the former scripts/ base explicit while tooling internals complete L5.
$MirRepoRoot = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "../../..")).Path
$MirLegacyScriptRoot = Join-Path $MirRepoRoot "scripts"

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$repo = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot).Path
$source = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $SourceRepoRoot).Path
foreach ($module in @("Core", "Records", "Planner", "Scenario", "Observation", "Evidence", "Views", "Context")) {
  . (Join-Path $repo "tools/lib/control/$module.ps1")
}
$context = Assert-MIRCPVerificationContext -Path $ContextPath
$manifest = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath (Join-Path $context.path "context-manifest.json") | ConvertFrom-Json
$controlLock = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath (Join-Path $context.path "control-plane-lock.json") | ConvertFrom-Json
$sourceCommit = ([string](& git -C $source rev-parse HEAD)).Trim()
$sourceTree = ([string](& git -C $source rev-parse "HEAD^{tree}")).Trim()
$sourceWorktreeSha256 = Get-MIRCPTrackedWorktreeSha256 -SourceRepoRoot $source
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $sourceCommit -ne [string]$controlLock.scenario_source_commit -or
    $sourceTree -ne [string]$controlLock.scenario_source_tree -or $sourceWorktreeSha256 -ne [string]$controlLock.scenario_source_worktree_sha256) {
  throw "Scenario registry source does not match the immutable context qualification-source lock."
}
$registry = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath (Join-Path $context.path "expanded-scenarios.json") | ConvertFrom-Json
if ([string]$registry.target -ne [string]$manifest.target) { throw "Context registry target does not match its immutable manifest." }
$result = Assert-MIRCPExecutionRegistry -Registry $registry -RepoRoot $source
& (Join-Path $PSHOME "pwsh") -NoProfile -File (Join-Path $source "validation/tests/compatibility/Test-MIRScenarioManifests.ps1") -RepoRoot $source
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Exact-source scenario manifest validation failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }
Write-Host "[ok] context registry binds source $sourceCommit and covers $($result.scenarios) scenarios, $($result.assertions) assertions, and $($result.batches) exact environments for target $($manifest.target)."

groups.independent_expectation: Four legacy path wrappers forward the same caller-bound arguments to their canonical test. The six substantive bodies retain the same registry/context calls and explicit error propagation through relocations.
groups.remaining_executable_check: No historical wrapper or duplicate path needs execution. Keep the current explicit complete host plan and fail-fast exit propagation.
groups.limits: This is wrapper intent consolidation only. Imported implementation versions are not assumed equal from identical call names.

groups.independent_expectation: Registry scenario/assertion IDs are unique; declared scenarios appear in batches exactly once; saved environment signatures match their templates; each batch has one template and includes only batchable scenarios; metrics match the registry contents.
groups.remaining_executable_check: Do not restore the generated registry, AST runner parser, context platform, old catalogue paths or count-based launch planner. Actual workload sharing/reuse still requires consumed-input review in the current named native case.
groups.limits: These assert the retired registry representation, not native behavior. Its template hash covers only template fields, not every consumed source/archive/save/harness byte. Projected avoided launches are arithmetic over assertion/batch counts, not measured process savings.

groups.independent_expectation: The context wrapper explicitly compares current scenario source commit, complete tree and tracked-worktree fingerprint with its lock, and rejects a registry target differing from the context manifest before downstream verification.
groups.remaining_executable_check: Retain actual current source/package/engine/mod/settings/save/harness/endpoint binding in the affected native scenario. Review uncertain shared inputs; reuse keeps the original result identity. This docs-only classification needs no additional native launch.
groups.limits: Named current guards/controls cover their own boundaries, not every private controller. Source fingerprints alone never prove native acceptance or equivalent gameplay workloads.

groups.independent_expectation: Both canonical wrappers stop when their independent scenario-manifest subprocess exits unsuccessfully; context mode invokes it against the selected source rather than the tooling checkout.
groups.remaining_executable_check: Keep fail-fast current controls and exact-checkout plan readback. Fix a failed product/fixture/runner/input according to evidence; never remove the check or treat structural validation as native acceptance.
groups.limits: The wrappers delegating manifest assertions does not dispose every assertion inside that callee.

groups.independent_expectation: The directly called manifest tests retain independent input/schema/path and named scenario expectations. These obligations cannot be dropped merely because the execution-registry platform is retired.
groups.remaining_executable_check: Reconcile the eleven exact manifest-test bodies and their named native/runtime inputs through existing CONT subjects. Preserve missing originals/unreviewed transitive helpers explicitly. No wholesale replay of every old test or source save is authorized by this intake.
